story.title: House Panel Holds Leon Black in Contempt Over Epstein Investigation
story.summary: The House Oversight Committee voted to hold billionaire Leon Black in contempt for failing to comply with subpoenas related to its investigation into Jeffrey Epstein. Survivors of Epstein have expressed support for the committee's decision and are urging for prosecution against Black following his contempt conviction.

timeline_highlights.title: New Mexico Files Lawsuit Against DOJ and Todd Blanche Over Epstein Investigation Access
timeline_highlights.summary: The state of New Mexico has filed a lawsuit against the Department of Justice and Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche, claiming they obstructed the state's investigation into Jeffrey Epstein's alleged crimes. The lawsuit was filed on the same day that New Mexico released a report detailing preliminary findings from its ongoing probe into Epstein's activities at a ranch in Stanley.
key_facts: New Mexico sued the DOJ and Todd Blanche.
The lawsuit alleges obstruction of the state's Epstein investigation.
The filing coincided with the release of a report on preliminary findings.

timeline_highlights.title: Leon Black Sues House Committee After Skipping Epstein Deposition
timeline_highlights.summary: Leon Black, a billionaire and former associate of Jeffrey Epstein, did not attend a scheduled deposition before the House Oversight Committee. Instead, he filed a lawsuit against the committee, seeking to block subpoenas related to its investigation into Epstein. Black had previously been subpoenaed in June after leaving a voluntary appearance abruptly.

related_stories.title: Rodrigo Duterte Appears in Court at The Hague for ICC Proceedings
related_stories.summary: Former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte made his first appearance before judges at the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague. The 81-year-old is facing accusations of crimes against humanity, with discussions regarding his health and memory impairment taking place during the session.

related_stories.title: Saudi Arabia Claims Houthi Drone Targeted Mecca, Warns of Consequences
related_stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has accused Yemen's Houthi rebels of attempting to attack Mecca, Islam's holiest city, claiming its air defenses intercepted and destroyed a drone deployed by the Houthis. The Saudi-led coalition emphasized that the security of Mecca is a 'red line' and warned of potential deterrent measures. In response, the Houthis have denied the allegations, labeling them as false.

related_stories.title: Escalating Conflict: Houthis Claim Downing Saudi Jet, Saudis Accuse of Drone Attack Near Mecca
related_stories.summary: The Houthi militia in Yemen has claimed to have downed a Saudi jet, while the Saudi-led coalition accused the Houthis of launching a drone attack near Mecca, which the Houthis denied. This exchange of accusations marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict, with the Houthis also threatening Saudi oil exports by seizing parts of Yemen's Red Sea.

related_stories.title: Former Kosovo President Thaci Convicted of War Crimes and Sentenced to 25 Years
related_stories.summary: Hashim Thaci, the former President of Kosovo, has been convicted of war crimes by a tribunal in The Hague and sentenced to 25 years in prison. The court found him guilty of crimes committed during Kosovo's war for independence from Serbia, including murder, torture, and illegal arrests. The verdict has elicited strong reactions among the people of Kosovo.
